description: Build a valid DMARC TXT record (to publish at _dmarc.yourdomain) from a policy and report addresses.

domain.description: The domain the record is for, e.g. example.com.

policy.description: What receivers do with fakes: none (report only), quarantine (spam folder) or reject (block). Start with none plus a report address, then tighten.

rua.description: Email addresses that receive the daily aggregate reports, e.g. dmarc@example.com.

subdomainPolicy.description: A different policy for subdomains. Leave out to use the main policy.

name: generate_dmarc_record

host.description: Where to publish it: the DNS name (host) of the TXT record.

toolUrl.description: The same check as a free web tool on pipefire.ai.

value.description: The record value to paste into DNS.

warnings.description: Things to check before publishing, such as nearing the SPF 10-lookup limit. Empty when there are none.

title: DMARC record generator
